page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz, using the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 1 physical core with 2 execution threads. Hardware-level features include standard AVX, AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and bit manipulation instruction sets, while lacking AVX-512 and AMX instruction extensions. The system offers 32 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache.

Hardware allocations provide 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local disk storage is not bundled with the server, necessitating network-attached storage for persistent block devices. Networking interfaces operate with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Hardware accelerators are absent, with 0 GPUs available.

Benchmark results highlight solid single-threaded performance offset by constrained aggregate capacity due to the 2-vCPU configuration. The instance achieves a strong stress-ng single-core score of 2691.19, along with average single-threaded compression and decompression figures (25.53 GB/sec gzip compression, 10.58 GB/sec bzip3 decompression). However, multi-core throughput is restricted by the low core count, resulting in weak multi-core stress-ng scores (2691.50) and a bottom-tier Geekbench multi-core rating of 1854.0. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 26.05 GB/sec, while write operations measured 12.61 GB/sec. Application tests yielded 2.05 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.18 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The ecs.r7a.large provides a low-entry, cost-effective deployment profile for memory-sensitive services that do not require expansive multi-threaded compute. Typical workloads suited to this architecture include intermediate caching instances, low-traffic in-memory databases, lightweight background workers, and memory-bound microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.large is a memory-optimized instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical AMD EPYC 7T83 core clocked at 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Designed around a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, it incorporates 16.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU) with 32 MB of L3 cache. It excludes integrated local storage and hardware GPUs, utilizing a 1 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmarks reflect robust single-core compute, shown by a stress-ng single-core score in the top 25%, balanced by lower multi-threaded performance due to the dual-thread ceiling. Memory bandwidth delivers 26.05 GB/sec for uncached reads, while Redis workloads reach 2.05 million SET operations per second. It is best applied to smaller in-memory data structures, caching services, and low-concurrency, memory-focused enterprise applications.
